actions.action: Check soil moisture with finger 2 inches deep before watering
Move plant to partial shade for a week, then back to full sun
Remove root ball and inspect roots, cutting off black/mushy roots
Trim dead brown stems back to green wood
Repot in terracotta pot with drainage hole using cactus/succulent mix
Overwinter in garage under timed lamp, watering when top inch is dry

reason: The answer diagnoses overwatering and root rot when the confirmed problem was underwatering in fast-drying terracotta, and it recommends stopping watering, avoiding plastic, and repotting into terracotta with fast-draining mix, all of which would worsen the drying out.
